prior_result: Combination 07 retained all 600 exposed v9 regression decisions and all 32 diagnostic decisions, but retained one Romanian error in both fitted and family-cross-validated development.
exposure: All populations are already exposed engineering data. No independent validation is claimed.
change: Extend the two centered logits and intercept with tanh(neural_margin/4), tanh(student_margin/4), and their product. The bounded features allow confidence-dependent combination without phrases or case identifiers.
fit: Same nonnegative linear logit weights and quadratic prior toward v9; the three additional coefficients are unconstrained with zero prior. Regularization strengths 1, 10, 100.
selection: Same leave-one-family-out selection on development only, then one challenge and regression evaluation. Calibration is not used for selection.
acceptance: All previous requirements remain. A fitted or cross-validated perfect score cannot qualify release. Preserve and report regressions.
